publication_type_basis: The publication presents classifier criteria as a guideline.

cards.interpretation: FIXTURE. Under Fixture Classifier first edition, GENEA mutation defines Fixture Entity One, recorded here as AML, where blasts are at least 20 per cent; 10 to 19 per cent blasts are assigned to Fixture Entity Two, recorded as MDS/AML. The criterion is defeated where a fixture-defining fusion is present. The source does not specify applicability to therapy-related disease.

FIXTURE. Under Fixture Classifier first edition, GENEB mutation refines an existing category without moving the major diagnostic category. The source does not state a blast threshold or an exclusion for this refinement.
FIXTURE. In the fixture cohort, GENEA mutation was favourable on analysis adjusted for age and blast count. The source does not state a treatment context for this cohort.
FIXTURE. In the fixture cohort, GENEC mutation had no independent prognostic effect after adjustment (negative fact; remove in final pass per R2.7).

FIXTURE. An earlier fixture series reported GENEC mutation as adverse on univariable analysis only, restated here without reanalysis. The source does not state the cohort size or the treatment received.

cards.interpretation: FIXTURE. GENEA mutation is a validated fixture follow-up marker and should be tracked with a high-sensitivity assay. The source does not state the assay threshold or the timepoints at which it applies.
FIXTURE. GENEB mutation is not validated as a stand-alone follow-up marker in this fixture setting (negative fact; remove in final pass per R4.7).

FIXTURE. A near-heterozygous loss-of-function GENED variant accompanied by a lower-burden second event is the characteristic fixture predisposition architecture, and warrants confirmation on a non-haematopoietic specimen. The source does not state which allele is constitutional.
